modes.standard_player: Autonomously maintain, repair and service the player's existing factory.
modes.independent_player: Plan, build, supply and defend the factory through the campaign endpoint.
modes.non_player_force: Coordinate production, construction, research and supply-chain defense across the force.

required_milestones: Sustain the actual science chains required by native progression to the endpoint, retaining unlocked terrestrial science capacity.
Research rocket prerequisites with real produced science and native research progress.
Construct, power and supply an owned rocket silo through paid construction and actual material transfers.
Produce rocket parts and appropriate payloads from actual supply chains.
Execute successful native rocket launches with real valid payloads, completing at least one entire launch cycle and responding to subsequent real demand.
Produce space science through the enabled profile's genuine game mechanics.
Deliver space science to real laboratories and complete research that consumes it.
Demonstrate continued production and supply after the first launch, including recovery from a supply interruption.

profile_requirements.base: Observe real launch-product production, payload consumption and subsequent laboratory research.
profile_requirements.space_age: Observe an owned platform, paid orbital construction, asteroid/material processing, zero-gravity science production and return delivery to research. Follow its native earlier rocket unlock rather than inventing production/utility science prerequisites.

evidence_rules: The Tech-Priests' own runtime behavior must choose and execute planning, building, supply, research and defense; an agent manually driving their tasks cannot satisfy acceptance.
No injected tasks, forced leases, manual executor calls or directed movement/build/research/attack commands may be used to make an acceptance run succeed.
Declared starting presets, passive telemetry, time acceleration and save checkpoints are permitted; staged diagnostic scenarios and assisted recoveries are never fresh autonomous campaign acceptance.
Recipes, costs, launch readiness and surface conditions come from the running engine.
A planned build, a ready silo or a launch request is not a successful launch.
A completed early-science or arena test is only prerequisite evidence.
Fixture-supplied packs, forced research, spawned rockets and injected space science cannot satisfy campaign acceptance.
Preserve actual item custody, force ownership and player-controlled automation.
